name: Conversation-native inference for voice agents
one_line: Sessions-per-GPU at p95 TTFT <= 300 ms as the product metric, delivered by session-semantic KV residency (predictive pinning + contiguous pinned-CPU restore) as a vLLM connector plus session gateway, sold hosted and BYOC to voice platforms and their customers; measured 1.5x on one seed/L40S/7B, which sits in the repo's own pre-registered kill band until 2x replicates.

numeric_claims.claim: Primary metric p95 TTFT <= 300 ms, measured client-side from STT-final to first streamed chunk
LiveKit serves Gemma 4 31B on SGLang with speculative decoding at 192 ms TTFT; $0.40/$1.20 per 1M tokens; inference concurrency 5/20/50 by plan
Inworld serves Gemma 4 26B; LLM under 5% of a voice minute; TTS 70-73%
ElevenLabs hosts Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B; Deepgram offers nemotron-3-nano-30B
Every orchestrator fetched except Bland supports BYO LLM via OpenAI-compatible SSE or WebSocket
Production default LLM sizes observed are 26-35B (Gemma 4 31B, Gemma 4 26B, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, nemotron-3-nano-30B)
Measured workload: Qwen2.5-7B fp16, 57,344 B/token, ~140 MB KV per ~2.5k-token session, median reply 75 tokens
numeric_claims.source: 02-evidence-ledger-voice.md header; vi-armA-baseline-knee ('~140 MB/session at ~2.5k tokens x 57,344 B'); vi-phase0-duty-cycle caveats (assistant tokens median 75)

founder_decisions.decision: Hosted endpoint vs BYOC vs open-sourcing the connector
founder_decisions.options: (1) Hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoint on own GPUs billed per line-hour; (2) BYOC package on platform GPUs (LiveKit, Inworld, ElevenLabs, Deepgram already self-host); (3) Apache-style OSS connector with a paid gateway and benchmark service
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Depends on who the design partner is and whether platforms will run a third-party plugin inside their vLLM; evidence to inform it is a partner conversation, not a measurement in the repos

founder_decisions.options: Proceed regardless; proceed only if a shipped session-semantic residency product appears; stop
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Wafer lists Vapi/Tavus/Inworld as logos and has a voice TTFT case study; Tensormesh sells KV tiering; SGLang has an open pin-with-TTL RFC; DeepInfra prices cache retention. None ships session-semantic residency or a sessions-per-GPU number. Whether that gap is durable is a market judgment the founder reserved

founder_decisions.options: Pitch 'fewer GPUs per line' to stacks where LLM is a large share of the minute (Retell frontier lines up to ~65%); pitch 'no cliff at p95 300 ms' to stacks where LLM is <5% (Inworld-style self-hosted)
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: The LLM share of a voice minute ranges from <5% to ~65% depending on stack; which buyer to target is a go-to-market choice

founder_decisions.decision: Model choice for the benchmark and the product
founder_decisions.options: Benchmark on the buyer's model; standardize on a 26-35B open default (Gemma 4 31B, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B); keep 7B-class for cost
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: All evidence is Qwen2.5-7B fp16; production defaults are 26-35B; the ratio on larger models is unmeasured

founder_decisions.options: Small-HBM cards (L40S $0.99-$2.25/hr) where the cliff is measured; H100/B200 ($3.29-$12.29/hr for H100) where the docs say the wall may move past voice-realistic session counts
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Both repos name the larger-HBM GPU as the #1 threat and neither measured it; conflict 5 arithmetic (cliff ~N 400-450 on 80 GB) is not a run

founder_decisions.decision: Fork vLLM for scheduler-native prefetch or stay a plugin
founder_decisions.options: Stay on the KVConnector API (no prefetch without a request); fork the scheduler to DMA-load and pin blocks without a request (the 'strongest remaining version of the thesis', untested)
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Trades maintenance burden and engine-drift risk against an unmeasured upside; the PRD forbade the fork and the repo did not test it

founder_decisions.options: Cascaded-only product; extend to Ultravox/Moshi-class models
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Continuous audio ingestion may collapse the idle window entirely; unmeasured

founder_decisions.options: Per concurrent line-hour; per GPU-hour with a sessions-per-GPU guarantee; per token with a pinned-session surcharge (DeepInfra-style 1.25x/2x retention write)
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Price per line-hour and unit choice are commercial decisions; the brief only shows the architecture makes a time-based unit expressible and gives derived cost floors

founder_decisions.decision: Sell to the platform or to its customers
founder_decisions.options: Platforms (buy capacity, BYOC); platform customers (buy an endpoint URL via custom-LLM SSE/WebSocket)
founder_decisions.why_not_ours_to_make: Different sales motions and integration surfaces; the research shows both paths exist but does not rank them
